clue.text: One born inherently to support sister?

indicators.note: inherently means within, so the one-and-born pair sits inside the support

parts.note: a sling supports an injured arm
one is the Roman numeral I
b. is the abbreviation for born in records and biographies

explanation.surface: Someone asks who, by nature, will stand behind a sister.
explanation.definitionFit: A sister is one example of a brother-or-sister relation; the question mark flags definition by example.

clue.text: Footnote about fish's glittering scale

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the footnote letters are read backwards

parts.note: PS, postscript, is a note added at the foot of a letter
to angle is to fish with rod and line

explanation.surface: A footnote discusses a fish that has a shiny scale.
explanation.definitionFit: A spangle is a small sparkling disc sewn on clothing, much like a glittering scale.

clue.text: Campaign around country building to rage

parts.note: a barn is a farm building in the country
to storm is to rage angrily

explanation.surface: A political campaign goes round rural areas and erupts in fury.
explanation.definitionFit: To barnstorm is to campaign by touring rural areas making speeches.

clue.text: One's going from country to country

indicators.note: going from means the letters of the word ones leave the first country

parts.note: Indonesia is a country in south-east Asia
one's written without the apostrophe gives ones

explanation.surface: Someone travels from one nation to another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One's' reads as a person, but it is the letters ONES, taken out of INDONESIA.
explanation.definitionFit: India is a country of south Asia, so this is a direct example.

clue.text: Added herbs from his garden

indicators.note: from signals that the answer is made out of these letters reworked

explanation.surface: Someone sprinkled herbs picked from his own garden.
explanation.definitionFit: To garnish food is to decorate it with herbs, so garnished means added herbs to it.

clue.text: Unruly as well as lacking a design

indicators.note: design as a verb means to work up a new arrangement, so the remaining letters are rearranged
lacking says the letter a goes missing from the words before it

explanation.surface: Something is called disorderly and, on top of that, without any plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking a' takes one A out of AS WELL AS, leaving SWELLAS; 'design' then rearranges those seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Unruly behaviour ignores rules, which is to be without law; a straight synonym.

clue.text: Problem one's disappointing answer

indicators.note: the 's stands for has, so the clue words have the answer inside them

explanation.surface: The first problem has an unsatisfying solution.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemon is slang for a dud that disappoints, here a dud answer.

clue.text: Capricious rule upholds that man thus

annotationWithheld.why: Capricious rule upholds that man thus (9): 'upholds' does two jobs, reversing LAW (held up, in a down entry) and containing HIM + SIC, so it is both the reversal and the container indicator
annotationWithheld.clue: Capricious rule upholds that man thus

clue.text: Official's hand on lead

definitions.meaning: in card games such as piquet the ... hand is the player who leads first

explanation.surface: A referee's hand rests on the dog's leash.
explanation.walkthrough: Elder hand is a card-game term for the player who leads.
explanation.definitionFit: A church elder is an official, and the elder hand is the player whose turn it is to lead.

clue.text: Cry of the fallen rocks church

parts.note: scree is loose broken rock that has fallen down a slope

explanation.surface: A lament for the dead shakes the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rocks' looks like a verb, as in the cry rocks the church, but it belongs to the noun phrase 'fallen rocks'.
explanation.definitionFit: A screech is a harsh piercing cry.

clue.text: Biting cold and dry outside

indicators.note: outside says the word for dry stands around the cold letter

parts.note: arid means dry
C is the standard abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: A biting wind is described as cold and dry when one goes out in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A biting smell or taste is sharp and pungent, the sense of acrid smoke.

clue.text: What one's left a memo about

indicators.note: about means around, so the memo word goes round the letter a

parts.note: a memo is a reminder note

explanation.surface: Someone wonders what they were left in a will, according to a memo.
explanation.definitionFit: The remainder is whatever stays behind once the rest has gone: what is left.

clue.text: Period for making an egotist?

indicators.note: the answer's letters are rearranged in order to make the clue's two final words, a reversed anagram

explanation.surface: Someone asks how long it takes to produce a self-obsessed person.
explanation.walkthrough: This works backwards: the answer, rearranged, makes AN EGOTIST. The question mark marks that inverted direction, and the surface plays on a pregnancy producing a person.
explanation.definitionFit: Gestation is the period of carrying young in the womb, so it is a span of time.

clue.text: Deadhead to take action over advertising

indicators.note: over means covering, so the legal-action word goes over and around the advertising letters

parts.note: to sue is to take legal action
PR, public relations, is publicity and advertising

explanation.surface: Someone threatens a lawsuit over a promotional campaign.
explanation.walkthrough: A sprue, also called a deadhead, is the waste metal left in the channel through which a casting mould was filled.
explanation.definitionFit: In metal casting a deadhead is the surplus plug of metal left in the feed channel; another name for it.

clue.text: Desire to go back about 100 years in time

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the turned word goes around the century letter
going back means the word for desire is read backwards

parts.note: hope is desire or wish
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, and a century is a hundred years

explanation.surface: Someone longs to travel back a century in time.
explanation.definitionFit: An epoch is a long distinct period of history, a span of time.

clue.text: Memorial to leader's character

parts.note: the head is the leader, and the possessive gives an S
tone is character or quality, as in the tone of a place

explanation.surface: A monument shows what a leader was like.
explanation.definitionFit: A headstone is a grave marker, a memorial stone for the dead.

clue.text: Dance put a stop to game

parts.note: a hop is an informal dance
to scotch a plan is to put a stop to it

explanation.surface: A dance was cancelled, which ended the game.
explanation.definitionFit: Hopscotch is a children's playground game of hopping through chalked squares.

clue.text: Quiet Kent resort upset about new mullet

parts.note: P, piano, means quiet in music

indicators.note: about means around, so the turned resort goes round the new letter
in a down entry upset means turned upside down, so the resort reads backwards

parts.note: Margate is a seaside resort town in the county of Kent

explanation.surface: A peaceful seaside town is in uproar over a fresh haircut.
explanation.walkthrough: MARGATE reversed is ETAGRAM, which goes round N. In heraldry a mullet is a five-pointed star, not a haircut or a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A mullet in heraldry is a star with five points, the shape of a pentagram.

clue.text: It reflected on five in gallery to smarten up

indicators.note: in places the reflected word and the five inside the gallery

parts.note: the Tate is a famous London art gallery
the word it followed by its mirror image gives it then ti
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Someone thinks about a group of five in an art gallery so as to look neater.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reflected' is not a plain reversal: the word is followed by its own mirror image, as if a mirror stood beside it. The Tate is in London.
explanation.definitionFit: To tittivate is to make small improvements to one's appearance, to smarten up.

clue.text: Assail with many a blow on instrument

parts.note: to bombard is to attack with a barrage of blows or shots

explanation.surface: Someone attacks another repeatedly with a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A bombardon is a large bass brass instrument of the tuba kind.

clue.text: It's seen on runners on a run

definitions.text: It's seen on runners on a run

parts.words: It's seen on runners on a run
parts.note: the runners are a sled's metal blades, and the run is an icy track for racing

explanation.surface: Something is spotted on athletes during a jog.
explanation.definitionFit: A bobsled travels on runners down an ice run in racing.

clue.text: Harlot using potted flower

indicators.note: potted means enclosed as in a pot, so the answer sits inside the clue words

explanation.surface: A woman of ill repute makes use of a houseplant.
explanation.definitionFit: The lotus is a water plant prized for its flower, especially in Asia.

clue.text: That girl's come to illicit bar

parts.note: she is that girl; the 's is read with the verb, as in she's been
been means come, as in has the postman been

explanation.surface: A young woman arrives at an unlicensed drinking den.
explanation.walkthrough: A shebeen is an unlicensed drinking house, a word from Ireland and southern Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: A shebeen is an unlicensed drinking establishment, an illicit bar.

clue.text: Mock attempt to reverse in vehicle

indicators.note: in places the turned attempt word inside the vehicle word

parts.note: a bus is a road vehicle

indicators.note: to reverse means the word for attempt is read backwards

parts.note: a go is an attempt, as in have a go

explanation.surface: A driver tries to back up while in a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Mock as an adjective means fake or sham, a synonym of bogus.

clue.text: Sail for port

definitions.meaning: a large jib sail on a yacht

explanation.definitionFit: A genoa is a large foresail, and Genoa is the port city in northern Italy.

clue.text: Intend utter deceit during this time

parts.note: to mean to do something is to intend it

indicators.note: utter means speak, so the deceit word is said aloud for a word sounding the same

parts.note: a wile is a trick or piece of deceit

explanation.surface: Someone plans to tell an outright lie at this very moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'utter' looks like the adjective meaning complete, as in utter deceit, but it is the verb, signalling a sound-alike.
explanation.definitionFit: Meanwhile means in the intervening period, at the same time as something else.

clue.text: Painter with long hair at last

parts.note: a mane is long thick hair, as on a horse or a person

indicators.note: last means the final letter of the word at

explanation.surface: An artist with flowing locks finally appears.
explanation.definitionFit: Manet was the French painter Edouard Manet, a forerunner of Impressionism.

clue.text: Point cad's revolver

parts.note: W, west, is a compass point
a heel is a cad, a dishonourable man; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: Someone aims a scoundrel's handgun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolver' suggests a gun, but here it is something that revolves.
explanation.definitionFit: A wheel turns round on an axle, so it is a thing that revolves.

clue.text: Squire left one bad news

parts.note: an is the indefinite article, meaning one
a downer is something depressing, bad news

explanation.surface: A country gentleman abandons someone who is trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A squire was the chief property holder of an English village, a country gentleman with estates.

clue.text: Remove right to have outside facility

indicators.note: having something outside means the facility word wraps around the right letter

parts.note: facility means ease, as in doing something with facility

explanation.surface: Someone takes away a right to an outdoor amenity.
explanation.definitionFit: To erase is to rub out or delete, so to remove marks or records.

clue.text: Lexicon includes beer, in a manner of speaking

indicators.note: includes means the lexicon word holds the beer word inside it

parts.note: dict. is the abbreviation for dictionary, a lexicon
ale is a type of beer

explanation.surface: A dictionary has an entry for beer, so to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: A dialect is a regional variety of a language, a particular way of speaking.

clue.text: Think about a German shepherd's club

parts.note: to mull over is to think about
ein is German for a

explanation.surface: Someone ponders a German herdsman's cudgel.
explanation.walkthrough: Shepherd's club is an old country name for the mullein plant, a tall woolly-leaved weed.
explanation.definitionFit: Shepherd's club is a folk name for the tall yellow-flowered mullein plant.
